premise: Hide-and-seek: Hedgehog hides so well that nobody can find him, until a snore gives him away and everybody joins the nap.
inspiration: Folk hide-and-seek games and the sleeper-who-gives-himself-away joke, turned: finding him means joining him.
lesson: The best games end with everyone together.

en-US.title: The Snoring Hiding Place
en-US.text: [excited] Hide and seek! Rabbit {rabbit:pulse} counted. One… two… three… GO! Fox {fox:hop x2} dashed behind the tree. {tree:pulse} Mouse {mouse:fade-out 1.5s} slipped under a leaf. Hedgehog {hedgehog:pulse} looked for the best place of all. Rabbit looked behind the tree. {sfx:rustle} Found you, Fox! Under the leaf: found you, Mouse! But where was Hedgehog? [curious] They looked in the moss. In the hollow log. Under the ferns. No Hedgehog. [whispers] He is very good, whispered Fox. They stood still. And out of a pile of leaves came a sound. {sfx:snore solo} [giggles] A small, prickly snore. Hedgehog's hiding place was so comfy he had fallen asleep in it. {hedgehog:wobble 0.4} Found you, whispered Rabbit. He did not wake up. [softly] Fox lay down on one side. Mouse curled up on the other. Rabbit tucked himself in the middle. {rabbit:hearts} And the best hiding place in the forest became the best napping place, with four snores in it.

es-ES.title: El escondite que roncaba
es-ES.text: [excited] ¡Al escondite! Conejo {rabbit:pulse} contaba. Uno… dos… tres… ¡YA! Zorro {fox:hop x2} corrió detrás del árbol. {tree:pulse} Ratón {mouse:fade-out 1.5s} se coló bajo una hoja. Erizo {hedgehog:pulse} buscó el mejor escondite de todos. Conejo miró detrás del árbol. {sfx:rustle} ¡Te pillé, Zorro! Bajo la hoja: ¡te pillé, Ratón! ¿Pero y Erizo? [curious] Miraron en el musgo. En el tronco hueco. Bajo los helechos. Ni rastro de Erizo. [whispers] Es muy bueno, susurró Zorro. Se quedaron quietos. Y de un montón de hojas salió un sonido. {sfx:snore solo} [giggles] Un ronquido. Pequeño y con pinchos. Su escondite era tan cómodo que se había quedado dormido dentro. {hedgehog:wobble 0.4} Te pillé, susurró Conejo. Erizo no se despertó. [softly] Zorro se tumbó a un lado. Ratón se acurrucó al otro. Conejo se metió en medio. {rabbit:hearts} Y el mejor escondite del bosque se convirtió en el mejor sitio para la siesta, con cuatro ronquidos dentro.

rustle.prompt: quick paws searching through leaves and ferns, a light busy rustle

snore.prompt: a small animal snoring softly from inside a pile of leaves, muffled, gentle and comic
